_comment: Badges. 'when' uses the SCHEMA.md condition language, evaluated at mission end unless 'live' is true (then checked every sol). Badges tied to real science carry source ids. No personal data is stored. Portions generated with the assistance of an SI tool (Claude) and reviewed by Team PlutonyX.

achievements.title: First Light
achievements.text: Finish your first mission, any ending.

achievements.title: Storm Rider
achievements.text: Bring the crew through a real severe solar storm without the shield failing.

achievements.title: X Marks the Sun
achievements.text: Fly a mission on a day with a real X-class flare.

achievements.title: Light Minutes
achievements.text: Ask Earth a question and wait for the answer.

achievements.title: Our Eyes Now
achievements.text: Decode the whole message from Earth.

achievements.title: Cliffhanger
achievements.text: Dil sat out a storm under a cliff and came home with the core.

achievements.title: Blue Hour
achievements.text: Watch a blue Martian sunset with the crew.

achievements.title: Many Happy Returns
achievements.text: Make sure Kofi's birthday message arrives.

achievements.title: Chief Engineer
achievements.text: Finish with Air, Power and Shield all above 50.

achievements.title: As Low As You Can
achievements.text: Finish with every radiation badge in the green.

achievements.title: Today's Sun
achievements.text: Fly a mission on live NASA space weather.

achievements.title: Commander
achievements.text: Reach any ending except Abort to Orbit on Commander difficulty.

achievements.title: By the Book
achievements.text: Bring the core home without taking a single gamble.
